1.web: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.
1.asv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father; But a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

2.web: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.
2.asv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing; But righteousness delivereth from death.

3.web: Yahweh will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.
3.asv: Jehovah will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish; But he thrusteth away the desire of the wicked.

4.web: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
4.asv: He becometh poor that worketh with a slack hand; But the hand of the diligent maketh rich.

5.web: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.
5.asv: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son; Buthe that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.

6.web: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
6.asv: Blessings are upon the head of the righteous; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

7.web: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.
7.asv: The memory of the righteous is blessed; But the name of the wicked shall rot.

8.web: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.
8.asv: The wise in heart will receive commandments; But a prating fool shall fall.

9.web: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.
9.asv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely; But he that perverteth his ways shall be known.

10.web: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
10.asv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow; But a prating fool shall fall.

11.web: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
11.asv: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life; But violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.

12.web: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
12.asv: Hatred stirreth up strifes; But love covereth all transgressions.

13.web: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.
13.asv: In the lips of him that hath discernment wisdom is found; But a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

14.web: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
14.asv: Wise men lay up knowledge; But the mouth of the foolish is a present destruction.

15.web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
15.asv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

16.web: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
16.asv: The labor of the righteoustendethto life; The increase of the wicked, to sin.

17.web: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.
17.asv: He is in the way of life that heedeth correction; But he that forsaketh reproof erreth.

18.web: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
18.asv: He that hideth hatred is of lying lips; And he that uttereth a slander is a fool.

19.web: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
19.asv: In the multitude of words there wanteth not transgression; But he that refraineth his lips doeth wisely.

20.web: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.
20.asv: The tongue of the righteous isaschoice silver: The heart of the wicked is little worth.

21.web: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
21.asv: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for lack of understanding.

22.web: Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
22.asv: The blessing of Jehovah, it maketh rich; And he addeth no sorrow therewith.

23.web: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
23.asv: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness; Andso iswisdom to a man of understanding.

24.web: What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
24.asv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him; And the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

25.web: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
25.asv: When the whirlwind passeth, the wicked is no more; But the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

26.web: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.
26.asv: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, So is the sluggard to them that send him.

27.web: The fear of Yahweh prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
27.asv: The fear of Jehovah prolongeth days; But the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

28.web: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.
28.asv: The hope of the righteousshall begladness; But the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

29.web: The way of Yahweh is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.
29.asv: The way of Jehovah is a stronghold to the upright; But it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

30.web: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
30.asv: The righteous shall never be removed; But the wicked shall not dwell in the land.

31.web: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
31.asv: The mouth of the righteous bringeth forth wisdom; But the perverse tongue shall be cut off.

32.web: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.
32.asv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable; But the mouth of the wickedspeaketh perverseness.
